svg.text: How a database actually stores bytes.
Old values pile up, so background compaction merges segments
and keeps only the latest value per key.
A read checks the memtable, then SSTables from newest to
oldest. Bloom filters skip files that can't contain the key, so
Updates overwrite the page in place, after writing to the WAL
first so a crash mid-write can be repaired. A full page splits in
Key may exist in many files, so
Key in one place: easy range locks
